recreation_notes.critical_details: the emotional contrast is everything — left guy needs to look like he's given up on life, right guy needs to radiate genuine confidence. paragraph_1.text: We are looking for 15 ladies aged 30-50 who'd like to learn about the science of setting & achieving goals.

paragraph_2.text: If you need help to organize your time, do deep work, and eliminate procrastination, try out our new easy and simple plan.

paragraph_3.text: In just 12 weeks you'll become your best self and strengthen your willpower. Spots are filling in quickly!

positioning.vertical: Below headline, occupying center of canvas

cta.text: Just take 1-minute test and get an anti-procrastination plan just for you

visual_mechanics.authenticity_trick: MS Paint screenshot format makes it look like someone typed this as personal note to share
visual_mechanics.pattern_interrupt: Interface chrome disrupts typical feed aesthetic
visual_mechanics.perceived_effort: Looks DIY, handmade, authentic rather than polished ad

reframe_psychology.shift: Procrastination reframed from moral failing (Laziness) to mental health response (Depression)
reframe_psychology.effect: Removes shame, opens door to seeking help

the_vibe.authenticity: Feels like personal note, not professional ad

must_keep: Handwriting/script font for all canvas text
Yellow pointing hand emoji after CTA

format_description: Extreme close-up product shot with handwritten sticky note attached directly to product, creating low-production-value UGC aesthetic that breaks pattern from polished ads

background_context.content: Lower back/t-shirt hem of person wearing jeans

product_focus.content: Extreme close-up of jeans back pockets with sticky note attached

layout_structure.visual_flow: Eye immediately drawn to white sticky note contrast against dark denim, reads message, then examines product

subject.body_part_visible: Lower torso, back view only - from mid-back to upper thighs

clothing.visible_details: Brown leather brand patch visible on right back pocket above pocket line

subject.psychological_role: Anonymous everymann - faceless allows any male viewer to project themselves

visible_elements: Both back pockets with double-stitch detailing
Brown/cognac leather brand patch on right pocket
Indigo denim wash with slight natural fading
product_detail.fit_visible: Slim fit evident from back view

sticky_note_element.position: Attached to left back pocket, slightly angled

physical_properties.type: White paper sticky note or small paper square
physical_properties.angle: Slight casual rotation, not perfectly straight

handwriting.style: Casual handwritten, marker or bold pen
handwriting.readability: Clear and legible despite casual style

sticky_note_element.content:
GUYS IN
THEIR 40S
ARE LOSING
IT OVER
THESE
JEANS
sticky_note_element.line_breaks: Each phrase on its own line, centered alignment
sticky_note_element.psychological_function: Creates social proof through generational in-group, implies viral word-of-mouth, handwritten feels authentic/unpolished

photography.angle: Straight-on back view, slightly looking up
photography.framing: Tight crop on back pockets and lower torso
photography.lighting: Soft natural daylight, even exposure, no harsh shadows
photography.depth_of_field: Everything in focus - deep DoF for product clarity
photography.production_value: Deliberately low-fi, could be iPhone photo

background.description: Minimal - soft neutral cream/beige wall or surface visible at edges
background.blur: Slightly soft but not heavily blurred
background.purpose: Non-distracting, keeps focus on product and note

color_story.dominant_tones: Cool indigo blues with warm mauve and neutral cream
color_story.contrast: High contrast between white note and dark denim
color_story.psychological_function: White note pops against dark denim creating unavoidable focal point

the_vibe.story: Someone stuck a note on these jeans to tell you something important. This isn't a polished ad - it's a tip from someone in the know.
the_vibe.scroll_stop_factor: Sticky note is pattern interrupt - brains expect ads, not handwritten notes

psychological_mechanics.primary_hook: Handwritten note creates curiosity - 'what does it say?'
psychological_mechanics.anti-ad_aesthetic: Low production value signals authenticity, bypasses ad skepticism
psychological_mechanics.social_proof: Implies widespread adoption by specific demographic (40s men)
psychological_mechanics.in_group_targeting: Men in their 40s see themselves; others see validation through specific audience
psychological_mechanics.urgency_language: 'Losing it' implies emotional response and virality
psychological_mechanics.product_credibility: Despite lo-fi message, product itself is shown clearly with quality details visible
psychological_mechanics.pattern_interrupt: Physical note on product is unexpected, breaks scroll pattern

must_keep: Handwritten sticky note directly on product
All-caps handwritten text with casual letterforms
White note against dark product for contrast
